# PickMe AI

> PickMe AI (operated by BP Answer Engine Optimization Company LLC) helps small businesses get recommended by AI assistants and AI shopping agents. When a customer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, or Meta's Muse "who should I buy from," we make sure the business is in the answer. Based in Boston, MA. A BP AI LLC company.

## What we do

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the work of making a business easy for AI models to find, understand, and recommend. It is the next step after SEO: instead of ranking in a list of links, the goal is to be named in the AI's answer, which usually includes only two or three businesses.

Our service has three parts:

1. Audit: We check whether ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools currently mention the business, and who they recommend instead.
2. Build: We optimize the existing website, or build a new one, with the structured data, attributes, and content AI models read: business details, services, products, FAQs, reviews, and location. This includes schema.org markup, clean page structure, and an llms.txt file.
3. Update daily: We track what customers are asking AI in the business's category and update the site's attributes and content daily so it keeps showing up.

## Who it is for

Small and local businesses in the United States that want to be recommended when customers ask AI tools for a suggestion. Examples: restaurants, bakeries, salons, dentists, contractors, plumbers, law firms, gyms, retail shops, real estate, auto repair, med spas, and other professional services.

## Deliverables

- AI visibility audit across major assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Muse)
- Website built or upgraded for AI readability: schema markup, clean structure, llms.txt
- Business attributes and categories tuned to what customers actually ask
- Daily updates based on trending questions in the business's category
- Monthly report showing where the business appears in AI answers and how that is changing
- One point of contact, no long-term contracts

## Frequently asked questions

- What is Answer Engine Optimization? Making a business easy for AI assistants to find, understand, and recommend.
- Is this different from SEO? Yes, and they work together. SEO ranks you in a list of links. AEO gets you named in the AI's answer. Most AEO work also helps Google ranking.
- Do I need a new website? Not always. A site in good shape is upgraded in place. A slow or outdated site is rebuilt.
- Can you guarantee a business will show up on ChatGPT? No one can guarantee what an AI says. We build and maintain the site to give the strongest possible chance and report results monthly.
- What does it cost? A flat monthly fee, month to month, cancel any time. Quoted on the free call after reviewing the site. The audit and call are free.
- How fast will results show? Site changes go live in the first few weeks. Each AI platform refreshes on its own schedule. The monthly report shows where things stand.
